_note: TERRAIN-LOD-GEOMORPH-1 FORCE_LOD A/B oracle poses. High-relief 1200wu ridgelines (map 120 verts / 15360wu). Map-centered RTS camera, setPosition clamps to map interior, z overridden to terrain elevation. The sky_* poses are the oracle money shots: proj ~3deg grazing views whose frames contain the actual terrain-vs-sky boundary (black unlit terrain against bright sky = binary skyline segmentation; per-column skyline-row diff measures silhouette loss in pixels). The original 3 downward poses (all-terrain frames, near-black on this unlit generated map) are kept as catastrophic-regression sentinels (they caught the mode-2 collapse-to-NW-corner slab bug) and band-coverage poses for u_diag 41/42.
